name: Orbital Desires 🛰️
source: Gao Chao Station was the embodiment of future wealth and prosperity, an orbital paradise for sexy women needing to escape Earth’s doomed gravity – and a place for them to find their every wanton desire tended to! Only a select few could afford it, but the thrills were worth it!
translation: “高潮空间站”正是未来财富与奢华繁荣的缩影——它是专供渴望逃离地球垂死重力的性感名媛们享乐的轨道天堂，也是令她们每一份放荡欲求都能得到周到伺候的销金窟！唯有极少数顶层权贵才负担得起高昂门票，但那份极乐刺激绝对物超所值！
